name: AniKoto
description: AniKoto (anikototv.to) anime source. Discovery via /filter and /home, detail and episodes from the ajax endpoints, streams resolved through the site's server chain including MegaPlay's AES-encrypted sources, with subtitle tracks.

name: AnimeCube
description: AnimeCube (animecube.live) anime source. Listings and episodes read from the site's Next.js payload; streams from the site's sources endpoint, with Dailymotion and Rumble playlists expanded into direct HLS/MP4 links.

name: BollyFlix
description: BollyFlix (new.bollyflix.vote) catalogue: Bollywood, Hollywood, dual-audio, Hindi-dubbed and Korean movies and web series, with the per-title quality table (480p/720p/1080p/2160p with sizes). Streams directly from the site's own mirrors — no torrent index, no debrid account needed.

name: HDHub4u
description: HDHub4u movies and series source (Hindi/Hollywood). Search, detail with episodes, and stream extraction through the site's shortener/link-bypass hops into direct m3u8/MP4 links.

name: HiAnime
description: HiAnime (hianime.at) anime source. Server-rendered search, home rows and detail with sub & dub episode lists; resolves VidPlay/MegaPlay getSources and Zoko's XOR'd player blob into m3u8/MP4 links with subtitles.

name: OttAggregator
description: OTT Metadata Aggregator: combines metadata from Prime Video, ZEE5, AirtelXstream, AppleTV+ with playable sources from SkyMoviesHD, Vegamovies, Cinevood. Resolves shortened links via HubCloud, GdFlix, and other bypass logic.

name: Prowlarr
description: Movies from your own Prowlarr instance, searched across every indexer you have configured there. Add the address and API key under Settings > Player > Prowlarr, and playback resolves through your Torrin / TorBox / Real-Debrid account. Every link is a magnet rebuilt from the torrent hash, so your Prowlarr key is never handed to a debrid service.

name: Torrin
description: Curated dashboard + latest releases from Netflix, Hotstar, ZEE5 & SonyLIV (TMDB, region IN). Resolves any title to torrents (Torrentio) and streams them through your Torrin debrid. Enable Torrin in Settings > Player first.

name: YTS
description: YTS movies and TV shows with full quality tiers (720p / 1080p / 2160p), seeders and sizes. Every link is a magnet, so playback is resolved through your Torrin / TorBox / Real-Debrid account (Settings > Player > Debrid). Sites in this family move domains often, so this plugin is standalone and can be pointed at a new mirror without touching the others.
